about: Name and search description of this site (the French lycée curriculum). Written in the source pages; read by build/mxbuild/site.py, build/mxbuild/offline.py (offline page) and scripts/export-slides.py (standalone decks); the pages read the name back from <meta name="application-name">.
name: Maths Explorer
description: Des chapitres du programme français, des galeries, des curiosités et des expériences pour explorer les mathématiques.
